projection.arithmetic: float64 vectors and dot/norm statistics; no post-projection clipping/rescaling/repeated correction
projection.class_components: Three teacher-predicted-class components of MMPR with the same global mass denominator; sum of vectors checked (atol1e-6 rtol1e-4). Use the total projection coefficient on each component: g_proj_c=g_u_c-alpha_c*g_s where alpha_c=alpha*dot(g_s,g_u_c)/dot(g_s,g_u) when projection is active; sum equals total projected vector. Report raw components and total projection blockwise; no per-class loss normalization
projection.native_comparisons: Supervised, R1, MMPR: FP32 vs same-Gaussian FP64 all 6 blocks and global; finite values, required global relativeL2<=1e-3 and cosine>=0.9999 unless both zero; no precision rescue after real forward

validation.relative_reduction: (macro_R1_error-macro_Q1_error)/macro_R1_error when reference>0; reference=candidate=0 gives0; positive candidate with zero reference or any undefined required metric fails F2; no epsilon manufacture
